description: Header file defining the LibMediaPlayerImpl class which implements MediaPlayer APIs for libmediaplayer integration, including callback registration and CAS data request functionalities.

classes.name: LibMediaPlayerImpl
classes.description: Implements MediaPlayer APIs to support libmediaplayer functionalities, manages callbacks, and handles CAS data requests.

methods.name: openMediaPlayer
methods.description: Initializes libmediaplayer, sets environment variables, and registers callbacks.

methods.name: requestCASData
methods.description: Requests CAS-specific information from the OCDM CAS plugin.

methods.name: eventCallBack
methods.description: Registers with libmediaplayer to receive status notifications.

methods.name: errorCallBack
methods.description: Registers with libmediaplayer to receive error notifications.
